subject: Re: Problem with the yellow toques

messages.subject: Re: Problem with the yellow toques
messages.text:
Hello Gabriel, 

 

 
Thanks for your message. 

 

 
I think I prefer the duller, more muted yellow rather than the bright orange-y one. But ultimately I like them both! Absolutely no worries on the colour difference, I’ll enjoy and wear either. Thank you for letting me know, and best of luck! 

 

 
Sincerely,

 
 McKinley 

 

 
 

 
 

 

 From: Lasclay <hey@lasclay.com>

 Sent: Tuesday, January 27, 2026 12:48:51 PM

 To: McKinley Leonard-Scott <mickkscott@hotmail.com>

 Subject: Problem with the yellow toques 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
Hi McKinley,

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
We want to let you know about an issue with our new batch of yellow beanies that we recently received from a new supplier.

 
It is really not the same yellow at all, and we are quite disappointed.

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
It’s not ugly, but it is not the same warm, vibrant yellow we were used to, and the one shown on our website at the time of purchase.

 
We decided to ship them anyway, since many people had been waiting a long time for their order and this was the only missing item.
 However, we will absolutely listen to your feedback and any requests regarding this. 

 
We look forward to hearing from you once you receive your order.

 
Warmly, and we’re sorry for this.

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 Gabriel 

Co-founder

Lasclay 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Lasclay inc.
